No changed tests or OAuth/network/credentials/browser execution.",

NotDone flags on the hostname thread do not override final source. Melissa reports stage authorization works but IMAP/SMTP is not yet hooked up and awaits a server release; acceptance is not end-to-end deployed authentication proof. Source current issuerIdentifier/external-browser additions are later context. Existing source lesson is reused; fallback proof is added separately to exact source reuse. No account credentials, live OAuth/token/mail server or tests executed."
